name: expert-auto-pwa-apk
description: Expert Auto - PWA / APK wrapper with dynamic Auto-Diagnostic integration

scripts.build:web: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src=['index.html','styles.css','app.js','sw.js','manifest.json','icon.svg']; fs.mkdirSync('www',{recursive:true}); src.forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync(f, path.join('www', f))); console.log('Web files copied to www/');"
scripts.apk:prepare: npm run build:web && npm run cap:add:android && npm run cap:sync
